name: Throne
overview: The concept of the throne in Scripture signifies authority and divine appointment, as seen in God's declaration to Joseph that no one will be greater than him except the throne itself (Genesis 41:40). The throne also represents the seat of rulership and judgment, exemplified by Pharaoh's throne in Egypt (Exodus 11:5) and the throne of Israel, which King David prepared for Solomon before his anointing (1 Kings 1:32-35). These passages highlight the throne as a symbol of legitimate governance established by God’s sovereign will.
